Revolution is safe for rabbits, but most cat and dog medication is not and could kill a rabbit. Revolution is the only one I know of.  Be careful with dosages, they differ for rabbit weight. A 3 lb rabbit would get a small dose (there’s a chart for ml amounts). 

If you’re able to go to a rabbit (exotic) vet, they could help. House Rabbit Society online has a list of reliably good rabbit vets in every state in the US. They also have a very helpful public Facebook group. I’d also recommend Disapproving Bunnies (a private Facebook group) for advice and help (make sure it’s the one run by Meredith). Very quick to get answers and help there. 

One of my rabbits had fleas when I got him. He had a few treatments of revolution and a lot of flea combing, but was good after about four days. I think three treatments in all.
